name: The Calling Station
tagline: Calls to see what happens. Raises only with a straight or better, and folds only when it's hopeless.

monster.expr: made_hand = "straight" or made_hand = "flush" or made_hand = "full_house" or made_hand = "four_of_a_kind" or made_hand = "straight_flush"

hopeless.desc: Almost no chance of winning and a big bet to call

table.why: A straight or better: the one hand the Station raises with.
Nothing to call: check and see the next card.
Weak cards and more than ten big blinds to call: too much, even for the Station.
The Station wants to see a flop.
Almost no chance of winning and a big bet to call: fold.
The Station calls to see what happens.

raise_to.desc: The total bet when raising: the minimum raise
